requirements.note: Four-across square centre-cropped grid with thin gaps, oldest (Feb 19) at top, opens at the newest at the bottom; day headings (Saturday/Sunday/Yesterday, then 'Thu, Feb 19' style for older days).
Push to a full-screen viewer at the photo's own aspect ratio (landscape 402x302, square 402x402); horizontal swipes page between neighbours; swipe down closes back to the grid.
Heart button in the bottom toolbar toggles Favorite/Unfavorite; a white heart appears on the grid thumbnail.
Albums tab: inset grouped list of all eight albums with a cover, name, count and chevron; counts update after deletes; opens a grid of the album's photos.
Select → tap several (blue checkmarks, '3 Photos Selected' title), Favorite favorited all; Delete shows a 'Delete 2 Photos' popover confirmation and removes them (1,500 → 1,498).
Favorites and deletions (and the updated album counts) survived a relaunch.

bugs: Returning from the viewer shifts the grid by about 40 pt instead of landing exactly where it was (B does the same).
tells: Album grids keep a heading for every day, so a 177-photo album turns into long runs of one- and two-photo rows with large gaps; Photos shows albums as one continuous grid.
Day headings stick under the nav bar on an opaque white strip, which Photos doesn't do.
Library uses only an inline title, with no large title at the top of the scroll.
A.scroll: Slow drags, hard flings over hundreds of rows and pulling past the top all felt native: thumbnails were already loaded mid-fling, with no blank or popping rows. The grid moves about 40 pt after returning from a photo.

requirements.note: Four-across square centre-cropped grid with thin gaps, oldest at top, opens at the newest at the bottom; day headings like 'Saturday, Oct 24'; a large 'Library' title appears at the very top.
Black full-screen viewer at the photo's aspect ratio, showing date/time and album; horizontal swipes page; swipe down (or the X) closes.
Heart button toggles Favorite/Unfavorite; a heart appears on the grid thumbnail.
Albums tab: Photos-style 'My Albums' two-column grid of eight covers with name and count; counts and covers update after deletes; opens a grid of the album's photos.
Select → checkmarks, Favorite favorited all selected; Delete shows a 'Delete 2 Photos?' alert and removes them.
Favorites and deletions (and the album counts) survived a relaunch.

bugs: Returning from the viewer shifts the grid by about 40 pt instead of landing exactly where it was (A does the same).
tells: The select-mode bottom bar is a flat, opaque, pre-Liquid-Glass toolbar with plain tinted icons, while the rest of the app uses glass controls, and it repeats '3 Photos Selected', which is already the nav-bar subtitle.
At the largest text size in select mode, the compact nav bar shows a small 'Library' over a huge grey 'Select Items' title, which looks wrong.
The date/time and album labels in the full-screen viewer don't grow with Dynamic Type.
Grid thumbnails are announced only as 'Photo', with no date, so VoiceOver can't tell them apart (A labels each with its date and time).
Delete confirmation is a centred alert instead of the action sheet/popover Photos uses.
B.scroll: Slow drags, hard flings over hundreds of rows and pulling past the top were smooth, with no blank or late-loading thumbnails. The large title collapses properly, and the grid moves about 40 pt after returning from a photo.

why: Both apps meet all six requirements and both persist favorites and deletions. A looks like a real iOS 27 app throughout: glass toolbar buttons in the viewer and in select mode, a popover delete confirmation, and dated accessibility labels. B's Albums grid and black viewer are closer to Photos, but its flat, old-style select toolbar that repeats the selection count, its labels that don't scale, and its odd large-text nav bar give it away more often.
